title: Talend Task Run Duration p95
app: Talend job execution logs via the Talend Management Console API to HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=talend:job status="SUCCESS"
| eval dur_min=round(duration_ms/60000,2)
| stats avg(dur_min) as avg_min, p95(dur_min) as p95_min, count as runs by task_name
| where p95_min>60
| sort - p95_min
description: Computes the 95th-percentile run duration for each task in Talend and flags the slowest, pointing owners at the specific content or jobs that need optimisation.
value: Tail latency, not the average, is what users feel; ranking Talend tasks by p95 focuses tuning effort where it removes the most pain.
implementation: Ingest Talend timing data; schedule daily over a trailing week and review the slowest tasks with their owners.
visualization: Table of task by p95 run duration, trend line.
grandmaExplanation: We measure how slow the worst cases are in Talend so the sluggish ones get fixed before people give up on them.
